gloss: family; clan; school (of an art or discipline)

definitions.explanation: A family group or clan sharing a common ancestor or family name. Often used in historical or formal contexts.

definitions.gloss: school; group of disciples (in an art or discipline)
definitions.explanation: A group of practitioners or disciples under one master, especially in traditional arts like sumo, rakugo, tea ceremony, or martial arts.

examples.japanese: {平家|へいけ}{一門|いちもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{滅|ほろ}んだ。
{一門|いちもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: To protect the honor of the family.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一門|いちもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長|おさ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られていた→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: That military commander was known as the head of the clan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一門|いちもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一門|いちもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入門|にゅうもん}→入門：11643_nyuumon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I entered a rakugo school and began my training.

notes:
Refers to a group united by blood ties or by a shared master in a traditional discipline. The word carries a sense of loyalty and shared identity.

SENSE 1 — CLAN/FAMILY:
Common in historical contexts, especially referring to warrior clans of medieval Japan such as {平家|へいけ}{一門|いちもん} (Taira clan) or ⟦{源氏|げんじ}→源氏：16644_genji⟧{一門|いちもん} (Minamoto clan).

SENSE 2 — SCHOOL/GROUP:
Widely used in traditional arts:
- ⟦{相撲|すもう}→相撲：00390_sumou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一門|いちもん}: sumo stable group
- ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一門|いちもん}: rakugo school
- ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一門|いちもん}: tea ceremony school

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一門|いちもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join a school/clan
- {一門|いちもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長|おさ}: head of a clan/school
- {一門|いちもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{率|ひき}いる→率いる：10879_hikiiru⟧: to lead a clan/school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一族|いちぞく}→一族：11229_ichizoku⟧: family, relatives — focuses on blood relations
- ⟦{門下|もんか}→門下：23488_monka⟧: disciples under a master — focuses on the student-teacher relationship
- ⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧: school of art — refers to the style or tradition itself
